spans.s:
मिक्ष् मिक्ष् or मिमिक्ष् (thought by some
to be desiderative forms fr. a lost rt. मिश्, contained
in the words मिश्र, मिश्ल, but referred by native
commentators to the rt. 1. मिह्, q. v.), मिमिक्षति,
मिमिक्षुस्, मिमिक्षे, to mix, stir up, to give a
relish to; (A.) to mix, be mixed: Caus. मेक्षयति,
यितुम्, to stir up, mix, mingle; [cf. म्यक्ष्.]
